Let f(x) is defined only for x ∈ (0, 5) and defined as f²(x) = 1 ∀ x ∈ (0, 5). Function f(x) is continuous for all x ∈ (0, 5) – {1, 2, 3, 4} (at x = 1, 2, 3, 4 f(x) may or may not be continuous). Find the number of possible function f(x) if it is discontinuous at :
(i) One integral points in (0, 5)
(ii) two integral points in (0, 5)
(iii) three integral points in (0, 5)
(iv) four integral points in (0, 5)
